statistics.clean_delta_confidence_interval: class-stratified paired recording bootstrap percentile 95% for ensemble predictions

interpretation_boundaries: All results are development diagnostics on 24 known validation MAT members; no test or unknown samples are opened.
The official metadata does not prove that MAT members are independent physical acquisition sessions.
Added-noise dB is relative to already captured normalized signal power and is not physical acquisition SNR.
CFO and multipath are deterministic mathematical stressors, not calibrated field-channel measurements.
Window-local zero padding makes the multipath result a boundary approximation rather than a source-continuous channel simulation.
No open-set, cross-session, cross-source, or real-deployment claim is allowed from this artifact.
